title: Feign Madness, Keep Your Wits
era: Warring States · King Xian of Zhou, year 14

source.quote: Feign ignorance while knowing full well; feign inaction when the moment is not yet right. Better to seem unknowing and do nothing than to pretend to know and act rashly. Keep the plan hidden — thunder stays inside the cloud.

moral: Hold still when it is time to be quiet: that is how the chance is kept.
